basic_info.description: Awash in light from its expansive bay windows, this sunny condominium is in a coveted location just around the corner from the shops and restaurants of Valencia Street! This bright corner unit has been thoughtfully updated for modern living while preserving its beautiful hardwood floors, ornate windows, and original molding. Ideally configured for entertaining, the expansive living room comfortably accommodates a dining area with iconic city outlooks. Boasting stainless steel appliances, quartz counters, and abundant cabinetry, the beautifully updated kitchen is a chef's delight! The generous bedroom has well-kept hardwood floors, and ample closet and wardrobe space. The updated bath is appointed with a charming vintage tub and floor tile. This lovely home is completed by leased parking for one car and private storage. A wonderful first home or pied-a-terre in the heart of the Mission, this condo is near City treasures as varied as Dolores Park and Valencia's night life. Very convenient to I-280, shuttle stops, and the 16th Street BART Station.
